description:
Title: Service for Your Fridge

Your fridge produces strange noises.
You describe the symptoms, and send them together with the type of fridge to the central fridge service center.
They select a local service facility (which all have their own way of interacting with customers).
The service facility makes an appointment.
They arrive at a random time, and sometimes have to leave without repairing your fridge, because they need additional parts.
After your fridge is repaired, you have to confirm that it is OK again.
You can rate the service facility.

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendSymptoms" targetRef="Catch_Appointment"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C4" sourceRef="Catch_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_ConfirmRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C5" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmRepair" targetRef="Gateway_Rate"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C7" name="Customer does not rate" sourceRef="Gateway_Rate" targetRef="End_Completed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Customer does not rate</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C8" sourceRef="Task_Rate" targetRef="End_Rated"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_D2" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="Task_ForwardRequest"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Repaired" name="Repair notified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing (additional parts needed)"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F_R1" sourceRef="Start_Rating" targetRef="End_Rating"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F2" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="Task_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F3" sourceRef="Task_SendAppointment" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F5" sourceRef="Task_AttemptRepair" targetRef="Gateway_Repaired"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F8" name="Additional parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Repaired" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F9" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
